title: Viva Insights: Consumption Dashboard shows Copilot Credit spend for Cowork and the Work IQ API
summary: Hold: the statement that viewing the dashboard incurs no charge is not supported by the Microsoft documentation checked. The access controls and roadmap facts are supported, but the licensing field should distinguish the published Viva Insights entitlement from the absence of dashboard-specific licensing.

claims.quote: "status": "Launched"

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The dashboard is on by default for eligible managers, Insights analysts and Global Administrators.
claims.quote: The dashboard experience is available to managers with at least 5 direct reports (scoped access), the Insights analysts, and Global administrators and is enabled by default

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a licence specific to viewing the Consumption Dashboard, so its licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Microsoft Copilot plans also include manager, leader, and advanced analysis for all employees who have an assigned Copilot license.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included. Replace the licensing notes and Licence to view bullet with: 'Viva Insights manager and advanced analysis experiences require applicable Viva Insights licensing; Microsoft Copilot plans include these experiences for employees assigned a Copilot licence. Microsoft has not published a separate licence specific to the Consumption Dashboard.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/setup-maint/environment-requirements. Keep the separate statement about metered service usage.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Consumption Dashboard page lists access roles but names no licence.
claims.quote: Consumption insights are available to Insights Analysts with global partition access, Managers, and Microsoft 365 Global Administrators.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the usage-based billing currency for Cowork and Work IQ APIs.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits are the common currency for eligible Microsoft AI experiences enabled by usage-based billing, including Copilot Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform workloads, and Work IQ APIs.

claims.claim: Cowork requires a Copilot licence and is listed alongside the Work IQ API for custom apps and agents among usage-based billing services.
claims.quote: Services managed by usage-based billing in the Microsoft admin center now include: ... Cowork (Copilot license required) ... Work IQ API for custom apps and agents

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Meter; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Charges come from using Cowork and the Work IQ API, not from viewing the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Consumption Dashboard Viva Insights reports takes no action spending policies users dashboard viewing charge'; opened ai-cost-dashboard, environment-requirements, assign-licenses, usage-based-billing-overview-copilot-credits and usage-based-billing-compare-dashboard-views.
claims.fix: Replace 'Charges come from using those services, not from the dashboard' with 'Cowork and Work IQ API usage is metered in Copilot Credits.' Replace 'The Copilot Credits it reports are billed for Cowork and the Work IQ API, not for viewing' in the cost rationale with 'Cowork and Work IQ API usage is billed in Copilot Credits.' Do not assert that dashboard viewing is uncharged.

claims.claim: Assigning a Viva Insights or Microsoft Copilot licence automatically applies a Viva Insights service plan.
claims.quote: A Viva Insights service plan is automatically applied when a user is assigned a Viva Insights license or a Microsoft Copilot license by a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator.

claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Insights Manager settings Consumption insights minimum team size Microsoft Graph API PowerShell'; opened manager-settings, feature-access-management and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy. No manager-consumption setting operation was documented.

claims.quote: As a Viva Insights Administrator or AI admin, you can set up and edit Manager settings

claims.claim: Granting manager-scoped Consumption insights requires granting manager-scoped Copilot insights.
claims.quote: You can't grant managers scoped access to Consumption insights if you don't grant them access to Copilot insights.

claims.claim: Manager access can be scoped to all managers, an Entra ID group, or a CSV list.
claims.quote: All managers ... Select Active Directory group, which lets you select managers based on Entra ID data. ... Upload .csv file, which lets you give specific managers access to team insights.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Minimum team size is configured in Viva Insights Admin portal > Settings > Manager settings > Minimum team size.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Viva Insights Admin portal with your admin credentials. On the left, select Settings, then Manager settings. ... Confirm or change the Minimum team size.

claims.claim: An API or PowerShell operation for setting minimum team size is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Insights Manager settings Consumption insights minimum team size Microsoft Graph API PowerShell'; opened manager-settings, feature-access-management and Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy. No minimum-team-size setting operation was documented.

claims.where: controls[1].note; What's changing; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Managers must meet the configured minimum team size, which cannot be below five and can be raised.
claims.quote: You can change this minimum to a number more than five, which is the lowest allowed setting. This setting limits access to only those managers who have teams equal to or more than that number

claims.claim: Learn counts team size as the manager plus all direct and indirect reports.
claims.quote: Team size includes: The manager; All employees who directly report to the manager; All employees who indirectly report to the manager through the organizational reporting hierarchy

claims.claim: Individual web-app access can be enabled through Settings > Microsoft Viva > Viva Insights > Set up and management > Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard > Users > Add.
claims.quote: Under Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, select Manage access settings for Microsoft Copilot Dashboard. ... At the top, select Users. Search for the people you'd like to add, and select them from the list. ... At the bottom, select Add.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId "Viva Insights web app" -Name DisableFeatureForAll -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone disables the web app tenant-wide.
claims.quote: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -FeatureId <String> -IsFeatureEnabled <Boolean> -ModuleId <String> -Name <String> ... [-Everyone] ... $false: The feature is not enabled by the policy.
claims.fix: Keep the call unchanged and add https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/exchange/add-vivamodulefeaturepolicy to sources; this reference supplies the full command and parameter syntax, while the existing cited settings page supplies the feature values.

claims.claim: The AI Administrator can manage web-app access.
claims.quote: Manage access to the Viva Insights web app for individual users and groups ... Applies to: AI Administrator

claims.claim: Disabling the Viva Insights web app disables the entire app, including the dashboard, Copilot Analytics, advanced analysis and admin tools.
claims.quote: Turning this control off disables the entire app, which includes the Microsoft Copilot Dashboard, Copilot Analytics reports, and advanced analysis and admin tools.

claims.where: controls[3].ui and api; controls[3].note; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant-wide switch for the Consumption Dashboard alone is documented, and VFAM lists no separate Consumption Dashboard feature.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Viva Insights Consumption Dashboard disable tenant feature access management PowerShell switch'; opened ai-cost-dashboard, manage-settings-copilot-dashboard and feature-access-management. The documented controls cover managers or the entire web app, not this dashboard alone.

claims.claim: The default policy's monthly spending limit is configured through Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Cost Management > Get Started > Set the monthly spending limit for this policy.
claims.quote: A side-panel with the title Activate the default spending policy for your organization opens. ... In the Set the monthly spending limit for this policy section, select one of the options. ... Limit monthly spending
claims.fix: Use 'Copilot > Cost Management > Get Started > Activate the default spending policy for your organization > Set the monthly spending limit > Limit monthly spending'. Keep the note that this configures the default policy. The omitted panel and section are headings, not missing navigation choices.

claims.claim: Global administrator or Billing administrator can perform the initial usage-based billing and default-policy setup.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Cap; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Cost Management spending policies can set monthly policy and per-user Copilot Credit limits for Cowork and Work IQ API usage.

claims.quote: The policy always uses prepaid credits first, whether through capacity packs or through pre-purchase plans, before moving to pay-as-you-go.
